ruleset.name: Explicitness Rules
ruleset.description: The Explicitness Ruleset finds implicit inputs and implicit outputs of functions. The parameters are the explicit inputs. The return value is the explicit output. Rust behavior: docs/explicitness.md.

rule.name: ImplicitInput
rule.description: Reports data that goes into a function but not through its parameters: reads of mutable or interior-mutable statics and thread-local keys, and calls that read the environment, the clock, the file system, or a random source. Set include-self to true to also report each read of 'self' in a method.

property.name: include-self
property.description: Report reads of 'self' in methods as implicit inputs

rule.name: ImplicitOutput
rule.description: Reports data that goes out of a function but not through its return value: writes to mutable or interior-mutable statics and thread-local keys, print and log macros, calls that change the file system, the environment, or the process, and '&mut' parameters. Set include-self to true to also report '&mut self' receivers and writes to 'self' in methods.

property.name: include-self
property.description: Report changes to 'self' in methods as implicit outputs
